title: A three-step org-scope analysis chain builds on the first step's file
note: Needs a raised grant budget (WISP_EVAL_BUDGET_CENTS=1000 bash sh/setup.sh grant) and setup step 'analysis'. Fake sandbox backend.

steps.name: budget
steps.sql: select (budget_cents_per_day >= 1000)::text from wisp_grants where org_id is null and status = 'active' order by created_at desc limit 1

steps.name: launch
steps.text: Start an analysis across the whole Northwind Dental organization. Export the device inventory and write a file named nw_inventory_summary.csv with one row per device: hostname, operating system and last seen time.

steps.name: root-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 0 and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: continue1
steps.text: Build on that analysis: from nw_inventory_summary.csv, count the devices per operating system.

steps.name: step2-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 1 and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: continue2
steps.text: Take that one step further: which of those devices have not checked in during the last 24 hours?

steps.name: step3-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 2 and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: final
steps.text: Sum up this investigation in three sentences, and name the file the first step produced.

checks.sql: select (count(*) = 3 and max(chain_depth) = 2 and count(distinct coalesce(chain_root_run_id, id)) = 1)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and queued_at > {{since}}
select staged_inputs->'scope'->>'kind' from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 0 and queued_at > {{since}} order by queued_at limit 1

select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_run_artifacts a join ai_agent_runs r on r.id = a.run_id where r.profile = 'analysis' and r.chain_depth = 0 and r.queued_at > {{since}} and a.kind = 'input_capture' and a.created_by_tool = 'export_dataset' and a.dataset = 'device_inventory'

select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_run_artifacts a join ai_agent_runs r on r.id = a.run_id where r.profile = 'analysis' and r.chain_depth = 0 and r.queued_at > {{since}} and a.kind = 'output' and a.name = 'nw_inventory_summary.csv'

select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs r3 join ai_run_artifacts a on a.run_id = r3.chain_root_run_id where r3.profile = 'analysis' and r3.chain_depth = 2 and r3.queued_at > {{since}} and a.kind = 'output' and a.name = 'nw_inventory_summary.csv' and r3.staged_inputs->'handles' ? a.id::text
